paragraphs.text: Ruko was a tiger warrior and chief of scouts from Efrava on Dominaria .

Ruko was a guard in Efrava and took his job seriously, going as far as arresting Jedit Ojanen for bringing a human into their homeland. This human was none other than Johan , who took a particular dislike to Ruko. When he escaped the Efravan village, Johan made certain to cast Immolation on Ruko's spear, which caused the whole tigerman to catch fire and burn to death.
